bio: In a charming location between Lake Constance and the Allgäu, just a few kilometres from Ravensburg, this lovely restaurant serving excellent cuisine is run by the Geßler family. Chef-patron Benedikt Geßler comes from a family of restaurateurs and has worked in several renowned kitchens. Here, he cooks modern, seasonal dishes, placing great importance on organic and Demeter produce. Choose one of two set menus (Chef Menu and Végétal Menu), from which, alternatively, you can order à la carte. The setting is extremely inviting, too, with friendly, professional staff serving you in a cosy interior with stylish details such as old oak floors, smart cherry-wood panelling and chic, comfortable seats. There is also a pretty terrace....
